# DocJacket Help Center

> Help documentation for DocJacket — the AI-powered transaction coordination platform for real estate professionals.
> URL: https://help.docjacket.com
> Product URL: https://www.docjacket.com
> App URL: https://app.docjacket.com

## About DocJacket

DocJacket is an AI coordination platform built for independent Transaction Coordinators (TCs) in real estate. It uses preparation-first automation where AI handles prep work (contract extraction, timeline building, email sorting, communication drafts) and TCs stay fully in control through approval-based workflows.

## Developer API

DocJacket provides a stateful real-estate transaction operations and intelligence API at
`https://api.docjacket.com`. The guides above explain it; the specification defines it.

The OpenAPI specification is the canonical machine-readable source of truth. Read it rather
than scraping the JavaScript-rendered interactive reference, which serves no API content in
its HTML.

- [OpenAPI JSON](https://api.docjacket.com/openapi.json): The canonical contract
- [OpenAPI YAML](https://api.docjacket.com/openapi.yaml): The same contract, YAML
- [Markdown API reference](https://api.docjacket.com/api-reference.md): Every operation as plain text
- [Integration guide](https://api.docjacket.com/integration-guide.md): Recommended call sequences
- [Developer overview](https://api.docjacket.com/developers): What the API does and how to start
- [API llms.txt](https://api.docjacket.com/llms.txt) and [llms-full.txt](https://api.docjacket.com/llms-full.txt): The API's own AI-facing index and expanded model reference
- [Interactive reference](https://api.docjacket.com/reference): Try-it console (requires JavaScript)

Authentication is a bearer token. Organization keys (prefix `mcp_at_`) act within one
organization; reseller/partner keys (prefix `rsk_`) are cross-tenant and accepted only on
`/api/v1/orgs/*`. A resource in another organization returns 404, never 403 — do not infer or
attempt access across organizations.
